name: traverses ragged one two and three dimensional sources in source order
restores next-leaf checkpoints in a fresh equal-shaped iterator
input: checkpoint after skipping an empty branch
test:
data = [[10, []], [20, 30]]
it = MultiDimensionalIterator(data)
assert it.next() == 10
state = it.get_state()
assert state['next_path'] == [1, 0]
assert it.next() == 20
restored = MultiDimensionalIterator(data)
restored.set_state(state)
assert restored.next() == 20
assert restored.next() == 30
assert restored.get_state()['next_path'] is None

name: validates checkpoint versions shapes and next paths
input: wrong logical source and malformed JSON-like state
test:
it = MultiDimensionalIterator([[1], [2]])
valid = it.get_state()
for state in [None, {}, {'version': 2, 'shape': valid['shape'], 'next_path': [0, 0]}, {'version': 1, 'shape': [], 'next_path': [0, 0]}, {'version': 1, 'shape': valid['shape'], 'next_path': [9, 9]}, {'version': 1, 'shape': valid['shape'], 'next_path': '0'}]:
    try:
        it.set_state(state)
        assert False, state
    except ValueError:
        pass
items = [[1], [2]]
snapshot = MultiDimensionalIterator(items)
items[0][0] = 99
assert snapshot.next() == 1
